raw_text: THREAD: Commercial satellite imagery reveals enhanced Pakistan SSG training activity near Kotli sector, PoK. Key observations: 1) New temporary structures at known SSG facility 2) Vehicle concentration suggesting battalion-strength exercise 3) Facility is just 12km from LoC 4) Activity pattern inconsistent with routine training. Indian intelligence likely monitoring.
